verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs say daily automated backups run for Pro, Team and Enterprise projects, kept 7, 14 or up to 30 days by plan. They also document Point-in-Time Recovery down to seconds of granularity, built on physical backups plus WAL archiving. A CEO response on HN independently confirms nightly backups exist and are relied on, though they caused write contention on a write-heavy workload. Missing for 10: backups are unavailable on the Free plan and PITR is a paid add-on; nightly pg_dump backups caused write contention on a write-heavy setup; no documented detail on restore workflow, cross-region retention or self-hosted backup automation.
